page.overview:
What is Marrok's lightsaber?

Marrok's lightsaber was the red double-bladed spinning lightsaber owned by the Inquisitor Marrok, once known as the First Brother. Marrok continued to use the lightsaber after becoming a mercenary by 9 ABY. The saber was capable of switching between crescent mode, single-bladed, and disk mode double-bladed. While not in use, Marrok hooked the lightsaber on the upper back of his armor. Marrok used the lightsaber against Jedi Ahsoka Tano on the Core Worlds planet Corellia and for the final time on the planet Seatos, where the former Inquisitor fell to Tano in battle.

In 19 BBY, the First Brother, a member of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius, carried the saber on his back, partially under his cloak, within Fortress Inquisitorius, Darth Vader, master of the Inquisitorius.

Marrok made use of his lightsaber during his hunt for Maul. Fighting off Eeko-Dio Daki and Devon Izara in Brender Lawson's home. Devon left Daki at Daki's order to assist Brender and his son, Rylee, in escaping the house. Marrok's lightsaber eventually lit the house on fire after a strike hit a wall causing it spark. Marrok came close to defeating Daki, though Daki dropped a light down on Marrok and escaped, following Devon and the Lawson's route to the roof of the home. Once Devon stole one of the TK trooper's ships, Marrok reappeared with his lightsaber and continued to duel Daki, though Devon opened fire with the ships weapons on Marrok. Marrok attempted to block the bolts to little success, which allowed Daki time to board and for Devon, Daki and the Lawson's to escape.

Despite that, Marrok continued his pursuit and found Devon and Rylee, split off from Daki and Brander, at a train station. Marrok and Devon clashed blades at the station platform and the duel soon moved onto a train. Passing a station, Maul got onto the train and revealed himself once Marrok asked where Maul was. Marrok handled both Devon and Maul, eventually kicking Devon away and igniting his second blade when Maul grabbed his arm, beginning the spin the blades. Maul ignited his own second blade and the two continued to duel until Maul threw his lightsaber, causing Marrok to leap back onto another flatbed, where Devon cut the coupling connecting Marrok's flatbed to Maul, Devon and Rylee's with her lightsaber, leaving Marrok stranded in the tunnel.
